It takes a lot of Godshard bars to create a set of Godshard equipment for end game. In addition, it takes a lot of time for Godshard ore to be smelted for bar from the forge.

 So, use Archer's Smeltin' Erryday Talent (Every kill has a N% chance to give N seconds of instant forge progress. Both Active and AFK kills count for Forge progress. Multikill also counts.). 

The reason for killing Gmush is that it's the weakest mob, while also being able to get Lab's Jewel effect.
Also speed is a factor for kph so that helps too
And there's a new green damage bubble that caps at 1B jade coins, which is absolutely nothing at some point. Pretty easy one to pump up, only limited by your 4th liquid cauldron production
